findings.summary: Criterion 5's 'sent back once' and 'send-back names the exact text' would go unshown. The planned run.rs unit tests repeat tests that already exist.
findings.evidence: The send-back text is built inline in the run loop (run.rs:1442-1454). No function exists that a unit test can call, so test (b)'s 'send-back message built from it' has nothing to call. The plan does not say it will extract one, and lists this as an open question. Test (a) and the unmet_criteria half of test (b) repeat run_pin_tests.rs `a_plain_criterion_reported_met_with_evidence_is_not_failed` and `a_missing_unmet_or_different_criterion_is_still_listed`. Both pass today. 'Sent back exactly once' is only asserted 'if the existing harness can drive a full run'. That harness does exist, but only in run_pin_tests.rs: `athena_with` plus a producer Tweak, and the test at line 722 counts producer invocations (`producers.len() == 2`). Decision 3 rules that file out. Fix: Move the send-back text into a named function in run.rs, e.g. `send_back_text(brief, &unmet) -> String`. Use it in the loop, and unit-test it in run.rs: the output contains the omitted criterion's exact text. For 'sent back once', add two full-run tests built on the existing run_pin_tests.rs harness. In the first, the producer report omits one criterion: assert two producer invocations, and that the second brief contains the omitted text. In the second, the report is complete: assert one producer invocation. run_pin_tests.rs is the test file for run.rs, so either name it as a deliverable for the verifier or explain why it counts as part of run.rs. Do not leave the demonstration conditional.

findings.summary: The producer cannot read job records, so step 1 as written cannot be done.
findings.evidence: The producer brief says 'records/, the owner's private files, and history are absent by design' (briefs.rs:224-225). The plan only touches on this in an open question. Fix: State plainly that the before rates will be marked unmeasured, with all six records named as unreadable from the producer's sandbox, unless the brief supplies them. Give the exact repeatable procedure, e.g. counting producer invocation records per job under records/<job>/invocations/ with detail containing 'self-check failed', so the user can compute before and after.

findings.summary: The send-back text still says '(without its number or kind tag)'. The new copy-the-line instruction must replace it, not sit beside it.
findings.evidence: run.rs:1446-1447: 'with its text exactly as given (without its number or kind tag)'. The plan says only 'align'. Fix: Say exactly what the new send-back sentence will be: copy each line from the brief's criteria_check section. Check that it matches the briefs.rs and outputs.rs wording.

summary: I read run.rs (unmet_criteria, criterion_key, and the inline send-back text at lines 1442-1454), briefs.rs (reading_sections, producer_brief) and run_pin_tests.rs. The plan fixes the cause in the right place: the producer-only brief section, the shared prompt shortened, field docs reworded, matching left as is. It fits the reading, and criterion 3's demonstration would fail without the change. Criterion 5 is the problem. The send-back text has no function a test can call. The planned unmet_criteria tests repeat tests already in run_pin_tests.rs. The 'sent back once' check is left conditional, even though the only full-run harness lives in the file Decision 3 rules out. The planner should extract a send-back text function, add full-run tests on the existing harness, and say plainly that the producer cannot read records/.
